    • layout

      public static List<ExpressionBreadcrumb.Tab> layout(net.minecraft.client.gui.Font font, List<String> names, int available)
      Lay out the tabs in the given width, as paths are shortened: the tabs in the middle that do not fit are collapsed into one, and the names of the others are cut off if they still do not fit.
      Parameters:
      font - The font.
      names - The names of the operators from the root to the edited one.
      available - The width.
      Returns:
      The tabs to draw, where a collapsed one leads to the last operator it stands for.
